component.name: Aureus
component.summary: A clean portfolio tracker that just works

description.p: Aureus is a native GTK4 and libadwaita portfolio tracker for Linux. Track multiple investment accounts, holdings, trades, cash activity, dividends, portfolio performance, and watchlists in an adaptive interface.

Aureus supports 25 account and portfolio currencies, historical exchange-rate-aware performance, stock search, PDF reports, and local portfolio backups. Market data is provided by Yahoo Finance, with Bank of Canada data used for supported exchange-rate history and reference rates.
Aureus 1.2.0 adds full multi-currency portfolio support and major market-data accuracy improvements.

ul.li: Support 25 account and portfolio currencies with a configurable Portfolio Currency.
Use historical exchange rates for portfolio performance, dividends, and reports.
Preserve native account, transaction, settlement, and fee currencies for cross-currency activity.
Match Yahoo Finance range performance for 5D, 1M, 6M, YTD, 1Y, 5Y, and All.
Keep persisted quotes as last-known fallback values while requesting live prices during normal use.
Improve portfolio range stability, refresh behavior, theme enforcement, and toast presentation.

description.p: Polishes dialogs and adaptive layouts, standardizes bottom action forms, fixes narrow-window scaling, and remembers the selected Overview chart range between launches.
Adds session-aware market pricing, extended-hours 1D charts, automatic stock-split handling, dividend cash credits, improved Yahoo Finance resilience, and Allocation refinements.
Improves Dividends, Allocation, pull-to-refresh, account removal, Watchlist sparklines, adaptive dialogs, and general interface polish.
Fixes same-day 1D portfolio return calculations and adds Bank of Canada attribution for exchange-rate data.
Initial release with portfolio tracking, accounts, cash activity, dividends, interactive history charts, reporting, backups, stock search, and watchlists.
